verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud lists AI-powered capabilities, including Grafana Assistant and Investigations (grafana-docs-45), and supports natural-language understanding of production systems (grafana-docs-8). Its Knowledge Graph automatically generates insights on errors, anomalies, failures and configuration changes, connecting metrics, logs and traces (grafana-docs-44, grafana-docs-59). However, no evidence explicitly shows the AI taking a specific alert or error and proposing a probable root cause; that is only implied by the feature names. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-driven alert/error investigation producing root-cause hypotheses, details of how Investigations works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
